questions.cardText:
[Agronomy] Which of the following currently does NOT have a genetically modified (GMO) version commercially available?
A. Apple B. Broccoli C. Papaya
Answer: B. Despite the prevalence of GMO crops like maize and soybeans, many common vegetables, including broccoli and carrots, remain commercially non-GMO.
questions.de: Welche Frucht hat eine gentechnisch veränderte Sorte, 'SunUp' (eingekreuzt in 'Rainbow'), die gegen das Ringfleckenvirus resistent ist und 1998 auf Hawaii zugelassen wurde?
questions.en: Which fruit has a genetically modified cultivar, 'SunUp' (crossed into the 'Rainbow'), engineered to resist the ringspot virus and approved in 1998 in Hawaii?

timeline.labelEn: Genetically modified ringspot-resistant papaya is approved in Hawaii
timeline.labelDe: Gentechnisch veränderte, ringfleckenresistente Papaya wird auf Hawaii zugelassen

questions.notes: A 'which is NOT' question: asked the positive fact it hinges on (papaya, like the Arctic apple approved in 2015, has a commercial GM version; broccoli has none). Source: Wikipedia, Genetically modified food (papaya section).

questions.cardText:
[Botany] What are xylem and phloem?
A. Plant tissues that transport water and nutrients
B. Types of plant hormones that regulate their growth
C. Fungal infections in plants
Answer: A. These tissues are like the circulatory system in animals. Xylem moves water from roots to leaves, and phloem distributes sugars from photosynthesis.
questions.de: Welches Pflanzengewebe leitet Wasser von den Wurzeln nach oben in Stängel und Blätter, neben dem Phloem, das die Zucker aus der Photosynthese verteilt?
questions.en: Which plant tissue carries water upward from the roots to the stems and leaves, alongside phloem, which distributes the sugars from photosynthesis?

timeline.labelEn: Carl Nägeli introduces the term xylem
timeline.labelDe: Carl Nägeli führt den Begriff Xylem ein

questions.notes: Reworked to one tissue to get a single short answer. Wikipedia: xylem transports water upward from the roots; phloem transports products of photosynthesis.
